text:
Source-assisted selected reading of F-vpe8 (Paris, BnF, NAL 2317, f. 7). The lines below were reread on the image by a research reader with Paris, BnF, Latin 3806, fols. 170r-171r and 175r-175v, and Liverani's printed text (snippets) at hand. All other lines of the leaf rest on the image-only first reading. (..) = expanded abbreviation; [..] = lost or not read; ? = uncertain; & = et-ligature.

Canvas 0, fol. 7r, https://openapi.bnf.fr/iiif/image/v3/ark:/12148/btv1b52513241j/f19/full/4620,/0/default.jpg, column a, native box 462,1500,2661,3500
 9  crebrius inuisenti .; Non fetor & lati cadaue
10  ris occurrat . sed occup& salus muros illius
11  & portas ei(us) laudacio .; Mater autem
12  huius defu(n)cti s(an)c(t)a eccl(esi)a . e(st) . q(ue) cotidie spi
13  ritales d(e)o filios gingere n(on) cessat quos creden
14  tes ex aqua sp(irit)u s(an)c(t)o regenerat .; Unde p(er) p(ro)
15  ph&a(m) dicitur .; L&are sterelis que n(on) pa
16  res eru(m)pe & clama q(ue) n(on) parturris .; Quos
17  cumq(ue) enim p(ost) baptismi gr(ati)am a peccatis
18  relabi uid& . hos quasi unicos filios
19  defl& ac gemit sicut faciebat paulus
20  ap(osto)l(u)s qui more paterno filios suos plange
21  bat dicens .; filioli mei quos iteru(m) partu
22  rio donec xp(istu)s form&ur in uob(is) .; Sol& e
    (first reading, fol. 7r col. a line 29: "nazarum?" is to be read "natorum" with Latin 3806, fol. 170r; not reread on the image)

Canvas 0, fol. 7r, column b, native box 2189,1400,4389,3500
 8  [c]onuertitur . uicia p(re)ceden[tia in] uirtu
 9  tib(us) comutantur . scilic& sup(er)bia? in hu
10  militate(m) auaricia in largitate(m) ebrie
11  tas in sobri&ate(m) .; luxuria in castita
12  te(m) .; Aliter baiuli funeris adolatores
13  sunt . qui du(m) male uiuentes inanis
14  laudib(us) extollunt . quasi terra(m) con
15  gerunt sup(er) mortuum iac[..]nt? ne is
16  qui ceciderat resurgere possit .; Sed
17  d(omi)no loculo tangente baiuli funeris
18  stant quia peccatore conu[erso] adola
19  cio cessat . quia ille qui p(er) p(en)itencia(m) se?
20  humilia(t) non solu(m) laude(m) n(on) requir[it]
21  ueru(m) &iam conte(m)[ptui? ...] .;
22  Tunc enim mortuus resurgit quando
23  peccator p(er) penitencia(m) reuiu[iscit]
    (line 15: the first reading had "iacuntem eis"; "ne is" and line 18 "conuerso" follow the source where the letters seen allow it)

Canvas 1, fol. 7v, column b, native box 1999,351,4250,2200
 1  in domum cuiusda(m) principis fariseor(um) &c(etera)
 2  Quociescu(m)q(ue) legimus d(omi)n(u)m ad nupcias siue
 3  ad c(on)uiuiu(m) inuitatu(m) uenisse . non gule uilece
 4  bris & ob ingluuie(m) uentris [..] uenisse
 5  e(ss)e eum? credere debem(us) sicut facieba(n)t scribe & pha
 6  risei dicentes eu(m) uini potato[rem] e(ss)e? . & amicu(m)
 7  publicanor(um) . sed anaduertere debe[mus]
 8  idcirco ad nupcias ut ad conuiuium uenis
 9  se ut q(uonia)m? multi congregabantur mul[t]i suo
10  exemplo ut doctrina erudirentur .; Sicut
11  eni(m) peritissimus piscator ibi re[te ...] ten
12  di[t] ubi scit multitudine(m) p[i]sciu(m) adu[nari]
13  Et sicut auceps ut uenator decipula sua
    ("ut" in lines 8, 10 and 13 stands where the source has "uel")
